homepage.introHeading: A Serene Sanctuary in the Heart of Jos
homepage.introText: Nestled on Justice Akanbi Close behind St. Piran Church, Kee Event and Garden offers a harmonious blend of refreshing highland climate, manicured flora, and refined covered halls.

about.heading: Where Moments Become Memories
about.subheading: A Legacy of Distinction in Jos
about.introParagraph: Kee Event and Garden was conceived with a single, clear vision: to give the historic city of Jos a premier destination that marries the serenity of nature with effortless, modern event luxury.
about.storyParagraph1: Blessed with Plateau State s uniquely cool and temperate climate, our estate provides natural floral canopies, velvet lawn walkways, and architecture designed to embrace open-air celebration while keeping guests sheltered in all weather.
about.storyParagraph2: From breathtaking wedding processionals along our manicured central lawn to distinguished corporate summits and joyous family milestone banquets, we take genuine pride in stewarding your most momentous occasions.
about.ctaText: We invite couples, planners, and corporate organizers for guided walk-throughs of our lawns, covered halls, and amenities.

venue.title: Distinguished Spaces For Every Gathering
venue.subtitle: Indoor & Outdoor Versatility
venue.description: Whether hosting an intimate gathering of 50 or an elaborate wedding celebration of 500+, Kee offers thoughtfully zoned areas with modern infrastructure.

spaces.name: The Royal Garden Lawn
spaces.description: Expansive, velvet-green lawn bordered by mature trees and scenic floral landscaping, ideal for open-sky wedding vows and large marquee setups.

spaces.name: The Emerald Pavilion & Hall
spaces.description: A stylish covered space designed for seamless all-weather comfort. Keeps your guests protected while maintaining a refreshing open-air garden connection.

spaces.name: The Sunset Terrace & Lounge
spaces.description: An intimate paved terrace framed by warm ambient fairy lights and garden planters, tailored for cocktail hours, VIP seating, or after-parties.
